image-alt.summary: Fluent <Image> requires an alt prop (or explicit presentation role).

button-accessible-name.summary: Icon-only Fluent <Button> requires aria-label or aria-labelledby.

dialog-aria-modal.summary: Fluent <Dialog> manages aria-modal itself; overriding it to false breaks modal semantics.

spinner-label.summary: Fluent <Spinner> needs a label or aria-label so its purpose is announced.

field-label.summary: Fluent <Field> requires a label prop to label its wrapped control.

menubutton-accessible-name.summary: Icon-only Fluent <MenuButton> requires aria-label or aria-labelledby.

dialog-title.summary: Fluent <Dialog> requires a <DialogTitle> or aria-label/aria-labelledby for an accessible name.

checkbox-label.summary: Fluent <Checkbox> requires a label prop, aria-label/aria-labelledby, or a Field wrapper.

dropdown-label.summary: Fluent <Dropdown> requires an associated Label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or Field wrapper.

input-label.summary: Fluent <Input> requires an associated Label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or Field wrapper.

radiogroup-label.summary: Fluent <RadioGroup> requires a group label via aria-label, aria-labelledby, or a Field wrapper.

spinbutton-label.summary: Fluent <SpinButton> requires an associated Label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or Field wrapper.

textarea-label.summary: Fluent <Textarea> requires an associated Label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or Field wrapper.
